title: Mechanistic insights into the lipotropic and atheroprotective effects of rosuvastatin-loaded glycerosomes in dyslipidemic rats.
authors: Mansour, Mohamed Fouad; Husseini, Rabab A; Abdo, Samar Ahmed; Khamis, Tarek; Mohammed, Haiam A; Alsemeh, Amira Ebrahim; Abdelfattah, Marwa Tharwat; Abd El-Emam, Mahran Mohamed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究瑞舒伐他汀甘油体对血脂异常大鼠的保肝抗动脉粥样硬化作用，涉及PPAR-gamma等信号通路及分子对接，但核心是药物疗效与代谢通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅分子对接为边缘方法。
abstract: Dyslipidemia is a major risk factor for the development of NAFLD, atherosclerosis and cardiovascular diseases. Rosuvastatin (ROS) is a lipid-lowering drug that protects against the development of NAFLD and atherosclerosis. However, the mechanism of this protection remains obscure. Therefore, the current study aims to explore the mechanism by which ROS-loaded glycerosomes (ROS-GLY) protect against NAFLD and atherosclerosis. Hence, for this purpose, hepatic lncRNA-H19/miR-130a/PPAR-gamma and aortic PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1 signaling pathways were assessed. In addition, these target pathways were predicted using molecular docking analysis. Thirty-five male Sprague Dawley rats were separated into control, dyslipidemic (poloxamer 407 (P 407)), P 407+ROS-GLY, P 407+NC, and P 407+ROS-GLY+NC groups. ROS-GLY improved lipid profile, hepatic MDA, SOD, catalase and total antioxidant capacity (TAC) in compared to P 407 group. In the dyslipidemic group, ROS-GLY downregulated hepatic lncRNA-H19 expression which leads to an upregulate of the miR-130a level and subsequent reduction of the PPAR-gamma level. Consequently, the hepatic expression level of lipogenic genes such as, ACC-1, FASN and SCD-1 was significantly downregulated in the ROS-GLY group than the dyslipidemic one. Aortic PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1 signaling pathway was significantly upregulated in the ROS-GLY group compared to the dyslipidemic group. Furthermore, ROS-GLY modulated IL-6 and IL-10 immunoprotein expression in hepatic and aortic tissues. Interestingly, ROS showed a substantial binding affinity with PPAR-gamma, LXR-alpha, and FASN, according to a molecular docking study. The current study indicated that ROS-GLY protected against the progression of NAFLD and atherosclerosis in dyslipidemic rats via modulation of lipid profile, oxidative stress, pro-/anti-inflammatory cytokines, hepatic lncRNA-H19/miR-130a/PPAR-gamma, and aortic PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1 signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 血脂异常是NAFLD、动脉粥样硬化和心血管疾病发生的主要危险因素。瑞舒伐他汀（ROS）是一种降脂药物，可预防NAFLD和动脉粥样硬化的发展。然而，这种保护作用的机制仍不清楚。因此，本研究旨在探讨负载ROS的甘油体（ROS-GLY）保护NAFLD和动脉粥样硬化的机制。为此，评估了肝脏lncRNA-H19/miR-130a/PPAR-gamma和主动脉PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1信号通路。此外，使用分子对接分析预测了这些靶向通路。将三十五只雄性Sprague Dawley大鼠分为对照组、血脂异常组（poloxamer 407（P 407））、P 407+ROS-GLY组、P 407+NC组和P 407+ROS-GLY+NC组。与P 407组相比，ROS-GLY改善了血脂谱、肝脏MDA、SOD、过氧化氢酶和总抗氧化能力（TAC）。在血脂异常组中，ROS-GLY下调了肝脏lncRNA-H19表达，导致miR-130a水平上调，随后PPAR-gamma水平降低。因此，与血脂异常组相比，ROS-GLY组中脂肪生成基因（如ACC-1、FASN和SCD-1）的肝脏表达水平显著下调。与血脂异常组相比，ROS-GLY组中主动脉PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1信号通路显著上调。此外，ROS-GLY调节了肝脏和主动脉组织中IL-6和IL-10免疫蛋白的表达。有趣的是，根据分子对接研究，ROS与PPAR-gamma、LXR-alpha和FASN显示出显著的结合亲和力。本研究表明，ROS-GLY通过调节血脂谱、氧化应激、促炎/抗炎细胞因子、肝脏lncRNA-H19/miR-130a/PPAR-gamma和主动脉PPAR-gamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1信号通路，保护血脂异常大鼠免受NAFLD和动脉粥样硬化的进展。
